verdict.rationale: Productboard documents a REST API v2 with personal access tokens that are explicitly 'best for internal tools, scripts'. It also covers full CRUD on product data and webhooks, so unattended, script-driven automation of the SaaS is possible. However, there is no first-party CLI, headless runner, or CI-specific guidance, and the MCP server requires interactive browser sign-in. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless mode, documented CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub Actions), non-interactive auth for agent/MCP use, and independent hands-on corroboration.
